G3880.definition: παρα-λαμβάνω; 1. with accusative of thing(s), like παραδέχομαι, correl. to παραδίδωμι, to receive from another: Col.4:17, Heb.12:28; of the mind, 1Co.11:23 15:1 15:3, Gal.1:9, Php.4:9; with inf., Mrk.7:4; before παρά, with gem, Gal.1:12, 1Th.2:13 4:1, 2Th.3:6; τ. Χριστόν (Lft., in l), Col.2:6. ; 2. C. accusative of person(s), to take to or with oneself: Mat.2:13-14, 20-21 17:1 26:37, Mrk.4:36 5:40 9:2 10:32…

G3854.definition: παρα-γίνομαι; (Ion. and late for -γίγν-),  ; 1. to be beside or at hand (Hom., Hdt., al.), hence, to stand by, sup­port (Æsch., Thuc., al.) : with dative of person(s), 2Ti.4:16. ; 2. to come, come up, arrive (Hdt., Xen., al., and frequently in later writers; see MM, xviii; Thackeray, Gr., 267.2): absol., Luk.14:21 19:16, Jhn.3:23, Act.5:21-22, 25 9:39 10:32-33 11:23 14:27 17:10 18:27 21:18 23:16, 35 24:17, 24 25:7…

G3844.definition: with radical sense, beside. ; I. C. genitive of person(s), from the side of, from beside, from, indicating source or origin,  after verbs of motion, Mrk.14:43, Luk.8:49, Jhn.15:26, al.; after verbs of seeking, receiving, hearing, etc., Mrk.8:11 12:2, Jhn.4:9, 52 10:18, Php.4:18, 2Ti.1:18, Jas.1:7, al.; after passive verbs, of the agent (like ὑπό), Mat.21:42, Mrk.12:11, Luk.1:37; absol., οἱ παρ᾽ αὐτοῦ, his family…

G3813.definition: a young child, a little one: Mat.2:8-9, 11, ff., Luk.1:59, 66 1:76, 80 2:17, 27 2:40, Jhn.16:21, Heb.11:23; of older children, Mat.18:2, 4-5, Mrk.5:39-41 7:30 9:24, 36, Luk.9:47-48 18:17, Jhn.4:49; in pl., Mat.11:16 14:21 15:38 18:3 19:13-14, Mrk.7:28 10:13 ff., Luk.7:32 11:7 18:16, Heb.2:13-14 Metaphorical, 1Co.14:20. Colloq. in familiar address (as Eng. colloq., "lads "-see M, Pr., 170n and Irish use of "boys")…

G3816.definition: 1. a child, boy, youth, maiden: ὁ π., Mat.17:18, Luk.2:43 9:42, Act.20:12; ἡ π. Luk.8:51, 54 (on the artic. fern, of address, see M, Pr., 70 f., 235; B1., § 33, 4); pl., Mat.2:16 21:15; of parentage, with genitive, Jhn.4:51 ; 2. Like Heb. עֶבֶד, Lat. Auer, Fr. garcon, Eng. boy (Æsch., Aristoph., Xen., al.), servant, slave, attendant: Mat.8:6, 8 8:13 Luk.7:7 12:45 15:26; in late writers (Diod., LXX: Gen.41:37, al.)…

G3870.definition: 1. to call to one, call for, summon: Act.28:20 (R, mg.; R, txt., entreat); hence (of the gods: Dem., Xen., al.), to invoke, call on, beseech, entreat: τ. πατέρα μου, Mat.26:53; τ. κύριον, 2Co.12:8; in late writers (Polyb., Diod., al.; rarely in LXX; in π., see Deiss., LAE, 176.14), also of men: absol., Phm 9; with accusative, Mat.8:5, Mrk.1:40, Act.16:9, al.; with inf., Mrk.5:17, Luk.8:41, Act.8:31, al.; before ἵνα…

G3825.definition: 1. of place, back, backwards (LS, see word). ; 2. Of time, again, once more: Mat.4:8, Mrk.2:13, Luk.23:20, Jhn.1:35 (and freq.), Act.17:32, Rom.11:23, Gal.1:9, Heb.1:6, al; pleonastically, π. ἀνακάμπτειν, Act.18:21; ὑποστρέφειν, Gal.1:17; εἰς τὸ π., 2Co.13:2; π. ἐκ τρίτου (Bl., §81, 4), Mat.26:44; ἐκ δευτέρου, Mat.26:42, Act.10:15; π. δεῦτερον, Jhn.4:54 21:16; π. ἄνωθεν ( Wis.19:6), Gal.4:9. ; 3. Rhetorically…

G3860.definition: παρα-δίδωμι, ;  correl. to παρδέχομαι, ; 1. to give or hand over to another: with accusative and dative, Mat.11:27 25:14, Luk.4:6, al.; of being delivered up to a course of teaching, pass. before εἰς, Rom.6:17. ; 2. to commit, commend: Act.14:26 15:40, 1Pe.2:23. ; 3. to give or deliver up to prison or judgment: with accusative of person(s), Mat.4:12, Mrk.1:14, Rom.4:25, 2Pe.2:4; id. before ὑπέρ, Rom.8:32; with…

G3864.definition: παρα-θαλάσσιος, -α, -ον; (παρά, θάλασσα)  ; by the sea: Mat.4:13.†; (AS)

G3885.definition: παρα-λυτικός, -ή, -όν; (παραλύω), ; paralytic: Mat.4:24 8:6 9:2, 6, Mrk.2:3-5, 9-10 Luk.5:24 (Rec., WH, mg.).†; (AS)

G3855.definition: παρ-άγω; 1. trans., to lead by, lead aside, lead into, lead forward, etc. ; 2. Intrans., ; (a) to pass by: Mat.9:9, 27 20:30, Mrk.2:14 15:21, Jhn.8:59 R, txt., Jhn.9:1; before παρό, with accusative, Mrk.1:16; (b) to go away, depart; metaphorically, to pass away: 1Co.7:31; mid., 1Jn.2:8 Jn 2:17.†; (AS)

G3820.definition: (πάλαι),  ; old, ancient; opposite to νέος, καινός: οἶνος, Luk.5:3; διαθήκη, 2Co.3:14; ἐντολή, 1Jn.2:7; ζύμη, 1Co.5:7-8; ὁ π. ἄςθρωπος (for similar phrases, see Westc., Eph., 68), Rom.6:6, Eph.4:22, Col.3:9; neut. pl., καινὰ καὶ π., Mat.13:52; of things not merely old, but worn by use (as Jo, l.with, LXX), Mat.9:16-17, Mrk.2:21-22, Luk.5:36-37.†; SYN.: see: ἀρχαῖος (AS)

G3853.definition: παρ-αγγέλλω; (παρά, ἀγγὲλλω),  ; 1. to transmit a message (Æsch., Eur.). ; 2. to order, command (Hdt., Xen., al.) : with inf., Act.15:5; with accusative of thing(s), 1Co.11:17, 2Th.3:4, 1Ti.4:11 5:7; before ἵνα (M, Pr., 207; Bl., § 69, 4), Mrk.6:8, 2Th.3:12; with dative of person(s), Act.17:30 R, txt., 1Th.4:11; before λέγων, Mat.10:5; with inf. aor., Mat.15:35, Mrk.8:6, Luk.8:29, Act.10:42 16:18 (aoristic pres.…
renderings: Give these instructions to the believers

G3819.definition: adv. of time,  ; long ago, of old, in time past (denoting past time absolutely, as πρότερον relatively) : Mat.11:21, Luk.10:13, Heb.1:1, Ju 4; as adj., with art., 2Pe.1:9; of time just past, Mrk.6:47 (WH, mg.), Mrk.15:44 (WH, mg., R, txt.); with durst. praes. (RV, all this time), 2Co.12:19.†; (AS)

G3850.definition: (παραβάλλω),  ; 1. a placing beside, juxtaposition (Polyb., al.). ; 2. a comparing, comparison (Plat., Arist., al.). ; 3. a comparison, illustration, analogy, figure (Arist., al.) : Mat.24:32, Mrk.3:23, Heb.9:9 11:19; specif. of the pictures and narratives drawn from nature and human life which are characteristic of the synoptic teaching of our Lord, a parable: Mat.13:3, 10 Mrk.4:2, 10, Luk.8:4, 9-11, al.; with…

G3845.definition: παρα-βαίνω; 1. in Hom. (twice), to go by the side of, stand beside. ; 2. In Æsch., Herod., Thuc., al., to go past or pass over, chiefly metaphorically, to overstep, violate, transgress (Jos.7:11, Eze.16:59, Sir.40:14, al.) : τ. παράδοσιν, Mat.15:2; τ. ἐντολήν, Mat.15:3; before ἀπό (as מִן סוּר, Deu.17:20, al.), to turn aside, fall away (cf. π. τῆς ἀληθείας, Arist., Cael., i, 5, 2): Act.1:25.†; (AS)

G3862.definition: παρά-δοσις, -εως, ἡ; (παραδίδωμι),  ; 1. a handing down or over, transfer, transmission (Arist., Polyb., al., LXX). ; 2. tradition of doctrine (Plat., Epict., al.); by meton., of the doctrine itself : Mat.15:2-3, 6, Mrk.7:3, 1Co.11:2, Gal.1:14, Col.2:8, 2Th.2:15 3:9.†; (AS)

G3878.definition: παρ-ακούω; 1. to overhear. ; 2. to hear amiss or imperfectly. ; 3. Later (as in LXX, Polyb., Plut.; also in π., see MM, xviii), to hear without heeding, take no heed: Mrk.5:36; with genitive, Mat.18:17.†; (AS)

G3824.definition: παλινγενεσία (Rec. παλιγγ-), -ας, ἡ ; (πάλιν, γενεσις), ; new birth, renewal, restoration, regeneration; (a) of persons (Plut., Phil., al.), of spiritual regeneration, διὰ λουτροῦ παλινγενεστίας (genitive attr., see Ellic., in l), Tit.3:5; (b) of the world, as in Stoics, Jewish Apocal., al. (see Dalman, Words, 177 ff.), Mat.19:28.†; (AS)

G3802.definition: (παγίς),  ; to ensnare: metaphorically, with accusative, ἐν λόγῳ, Mat.22:15 (not elsewhere).†; (AS)

G3842.definition: adv. ; of time ; (πᾶς),  ; in late writers (once in Arist.) for διαπαντός, ἑκάστοτε, at all times, always: Mat.26:11, Mrk.14:7, Luk.15:31, Jhn.6:34, Rom.1:10, and frequently in Paul. Epp ; (AS)

G3817.definition: to strike, smite: with the hand or fist, Mat.26:68, Luk.22:64; with a sword, Mrk.14:47, Jhn.18:10; of a reptile, to sting: Rev.9:5.†; (AS)

G3814.definition: 1. a young girl, a maiden (נַעֲרָה, Rut.4:12). ; 2. Colloq., a young female slave, a maid-servant (see Kennedy, Sources, 40 f.; Deiss., LAE, 186, 332.2): Mat.26:69, Mrk.14:66, 69, Luk.12:45 22:56, Jhn.18:17, Act.12:13 16:16; of Hagar, Gal.4:22-23, 30" (LXX) ; id., metaphorically, Gal.4:31.†; SYN.: see: παῖς (AS)

G3899.definition: παρα-πορεύομαι; 1. to go beside, accom­pany. ; 2. to go past, pass by: Mat.27:39, Mrk.11:20 15:29; before διά, with genitive, Mrk.2:23 9:30 (WH, mg.).†; (AS)

G3840.definition: adv. (πᾶς),  ; from all sides: Mrk.1:45, Luk.19:43, Heb.9:4.†; (AS)

G3858.definition: παρα-δέχομαι; to receive, admit; (a) of things: Mrk.4:20, Act.15:4 16:21 22:18, 1Ti.5:19; (b) of persons: Heb.12:6 (LXX).†; (AS)

G3812.definition: (παιδίον), ; adv.,  ; = cl. ἐκ παιδός, παιδίον, from childhood: Mrk.9:21.†; (AS)

G3868.definition: παρ-αιτέομαι, -οῦμαι; 1. to beg of or from another: Mrk.15:6 (Rec. ὅνπερ ᾐτοῦντο, see Field, Notes, 43). ; 2. to deprecate; (a) prop., with neg., to entreat that not (Thuc., al.): Heb.12:19; (b) to refuse, decline, avoid: o. accusative, 1Ti.4:7 5:11, 2Ti.2:23, Tit.3:10, Heb.12:25 (EV; but see Field, Notes, 234). ; 3. to beg off, ask to be excused, excuse (Polyb., al.) : Luk.14:18-19 (Heb.12:25, Field, l.with).†; (AS)

G3877.definition: παρ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ; with dative, to follow closely, accompany. Metaphorical, in various senses, ; (a) to result: Mrk.16:17; (b) to follow up, trace, investigate: Luk.1:3 (so frequently in cl.); (with) to follow as a standard of conduct: 1Ti.4:6, 2Ti.3:10. (For exx. from π., see MM, xviii.)†; (AS)

G3874.definition: παρά-κλησις, -εως, ἡ; (παρακαλέω),  ; 1. a calling to one's aid, summons (Thus.), hence, appeal, entreaty (Strab., Plut., al., 1Ma.10:24; of. Lft., Notes, 20) : 2Co.8:4. ; 2. exhortation, encouragement: Act.15:31, Rom.12:8, 1Co.14:3, 2Co.8:17, Php.2:1, 1Th.2:3, 1Ti.4:13, Heb.12:5; λόγος (τῆς) π., Act.13:15, Heb.13:22; υἱὸς π., Act.4:36. ; 3. consolation, comfort (Phalar., LXX) : Luk.6:24, Act.9:31, 2Co.1:4-7 7:4 7:7…

G3800.definition: ὄψώνιον, -ου, τό; (ὀψον- see: ὀψάριον— and ὠνέομαι),  ; 1. provisions, provision-money, soldiers' pay: Luk.3:14, 1Co.9:7. ; 2. Generally, wages, hire: 2Co.11:8; ὄ. τῆς ἁμαρτίας, Rom.6:23 (see Deiss, BS, 148, 266).†; (AS)

G3843.definition: adv. (πάς),  ; altogether, by all means; (a) without neg. (from Hdt. on) : 1Co.16:12; esp. in strong affirmations, surely, at all events: Luk.4:23, Act.21:22 28:4, 1Co.9:10; (b) with neg. (so always in mom.), in a complete negation: Rom.3:9; in a partial negation (Bl., § 75, 7), 1Co.5:10.†; (AS)

G3886.definition: παρα-λύω; 1. to loose from the side, set free. ; 2. to weaken, enfeeble; pass., to be en­feebled, esp. by a paralytic stroke: Luk.5:18, 24, Act.8:7 9:33, Heb.12:12" (LXX) .†; (AS)

G3861.definition: (παρά, δόξα),  ; contrary to received opinion, incredible, marvellous: pl., Luk.5:26.†; SYN.: see: δύναμις (AS)

G3882.definition: παρ-άλιος, -ον; (in cl., chiefly -α, -ον),  ; by the sea; ἡ π. (sc. χώρα, in LXX ἡ παραλία, Deu.1:7, Jos.9:1, Jdth.1:7, al.), the sea coast: Luk.6:17.†; (AS)

G3871.definition: παρα-καλύπτω; to cover by hanging something beside, to hide: metaphorically (as Plat., al.), Luk.9:45.†; (AS)

G3829.definition: παν-δοχεῖον (-δοκίον, Τ), -ου, τό ; (πανδοχεύς), ; late form of Att.. πανδοκεῖον, ; an inn (khân, caravanserai): Luk.10:34.†; (AS)

G3830.definition: παν-δοχεύς, -έως, ὁ; (πᾶς, δέχομαι), ; late form of the Att.. πανδοκεύς (T, in l), ; an innkeeper, host: Luk.10:35.†; (AS)

G3869.definition: παρα-καθίζω; to set beside; act. for mid., to sit down beside: Luk.10:39, Rec. (for -έζομαι, which see).†; (AS)

G3833.definition: (πᾶς, ὅπλον)  ; full armour: Luk.11:22; metaphorically (cf. Wis, l.with), τ. θεοῦ, Eph.6:11, 13 †; (AS)

G3822.definition: (παλαιός),  ; to make or declare old: Heb.8:13; pass., to become old: of things worn out by time and use (cf. Jhn.9:13, Isa.50:9, al., and see: παλαιός), Luk.12:33, Heb.1:11" (LXX) ; τὸ παλαιούμενον, Heb.8:13 (where this and the act., see supr., may have the sense of abrogate, see LS, Zorell, see word).†; SYN.: γηράσκω (AS)

G3838.definition: (πᾶς, τέλος),  ; all-complete, entire, perfect; εἰς τ. παντελές, completely, utterly: Luk.13:11, Heb.7:25 (where perhaps in temp. sense, finally; see MM, xviii).†; (AS)

G3834.definition: (πανοῦργος),  ; cleverness, in cl. nearly always in bad sense, craftiness, cunning, knavery: Luk.20:23, 1Co.3:19 (LXX, φρόνησις, for עׇרְמָה) 2Co.4:2 11:3, Eph.4:14.†; (AS)

G3803.definition: (πήγνυμι),  ; poët. (Aristoph., al.) and late for πάγη, a trap, snare; metaphorically (as also in cl.): Luk.21:35, Rom.11:9" (LXX) 1Ti.3:7 6:9, 2Ti.2:26.†; (AS)

G3811.definition: (παίς),  ; 1. as in cl., to train children, hence, generally, to teach, instruct: Act.7:22 22:3, 1Ti.1:20, Tit.2:12. ; 2. As in LXX (Psa.6:2, Pro.19:18, Wis.3:5, al., and for prob. ex. from π., see MM, xviii), to chasten, correct, chastise: Luk.23:16, 22, 2Ti.2:25, Heb.12:7, 10; of divine chastening, 1Co.11:32, 2Co.6:9, Heb.12:6, Rev.3:19.†; SYN.: διδάσκω, q.v (AS)

G3826.definition: πανπληθεί (Rec. παμπλ-, see WH, App., 150), ; adv. (πᾶς, πλῆθος), ; = cl. παμπληθές, with the whole multitude, all together: Luk.23:18.† ; (AS)

G3857.definition: (an Oriental word, first used by Xen. of the parks of Persian kings and nobles)  ; 1. a park, pleasure-ground, garden (LXX), an orchard (in π., see MM, ii, xviii; Deiss., BS, 148). ; 2. Paradise, the abode of the blessed dead: Luk.23:43, 2Co.12:4, Rev.2:7.†; (AS)

G3879.definition: παρα-κύπτω; 1. to stoop sideways. ; 2. to stoop to look: Luk.24:12 (R, txt.), Jhn.20:5, 11, Metaphorical (see Hort, Ja., in l), to look into: before εἰς, Jas.1:25, 1Pe.1:12.†; (AS)

G3849.definition: παρα-βιάζομαι; 1. prop., to force against nature or law. ; 2. to compel by force (Polyb.). ; 3. to constrain by entreaty (Ge, 1Sam, ll. with): Luk.24:29, Act.16:15.†; (AS)

G3808.definition: a little boy, a lad (in late and colloq. Gk. the word seems to be used with greater latitude and even to lose its dimin. force entirely; cf. Tob.6:2-3, and see MM, xviii): Jhn.6:9.†; SYN.: see: παῖς (AS)

G3888.definition: παρα-μυθέομαι, -οῦμαι; 1. to en­courage, exhort. ; 2. to comfort, console: with accusative of person(s), Jhn.11:31, 1Th.2:11 5:14; id. before περί, Jhn.11:19.†; SYN.: παρακαλέω (AS)

G3875.definition: παρά-κλητος, -ον; (παρακαλεω),  ; called to one's aid in a judicial cause (Dion. Cass.); hence, most frequently as subst., ὁ π., an advocate, pleader, intercessor (Dem., al.; so in Rabbinic lit., פְּרַקְלִיטָא), "a friend of the accused person, called to speak to his character, or otherwise enlist sympathy in his favour" (Field, Notes, 102). In NT, specif., ὁ π., ; (a) of Christ, 1Jn.2:1 (see ICC, Jo. Epp., 23 ff.)…

G3828.definition: Pamphylia, a province of Asia Minor: Act.2:10 13:13 14:24 15:38 27:5.†; (AS)

G3852.definition: παρ-αγγελία, -ας, ἡ; (παραγγέλλω), ; an instruction, charge, com­mand: Act.5:28 16:24, 1Th.4:2, 1Ti.1:5 1:18. (In Xen., Polyb., of a military order.)†; (AS)

G3865.definition: παρα-θεωρέω, -ῶ ; 1. to examine side by side, compare. ; 2. to over­look, neglect: pass., Act.6:1.†; (AS)

G3832.definition: πανοικεί (Rec., LTr., -κί), adv. ; (πᾶς, οἶκος), a word rejected by strict Atticists, though found once in Plat. (Eryx., 392c); with all the household: Act.16:34.†; (AS)

G3846.definition: παρα-βάλλω; 1. to throw to or beside, as fodder to horses (Hom., al.). ; 2. to lay beside, compare (Hdt., Plat., al.): Mrk.4:30, Rec. ; 3. Reflexive, to betake oneself, come near; of seamen, to cross over: εἰς Σάμον, Act.20:15. ; 4. In mid. = παραβολεύομαι, which see†; (AS)

G3896.definition: παρα-πλέω ; to sail by or past: with accusative, Act.20:16.†; (AS)

G3891.definition: παρα-νομέω, ῶ; to be a παράνομος, to transgress the law: Act.23:3.†; (AS)

G3805.definition: (πάσχω), ; 1. one who has suffered. ; 2. subject to suffering (R, mg., see M, Pr., 222) or destined to suffer (AV, R, txt.): Act.26:23.†; (AS)

G3881.definition: παρα-λέγω ; to lay beside; mid., ; (a) to lie beside (Hom.); (b) later, of sailors, to sail past: with accusative, Act.27:8, 13.†; (AS)

G3867.definition: παρ-αινέω, -ω; to exhort, advise: with accusative of person(s) and inf. (see Bl., § 72, 5; M, Pr., 205), Act.27:22; absol., before λέγων, Act.27:9.†; (AS)

G3806.definition: (πάιτχω),  ; like πάθημα; ; 1. that which befalls one, that which one suffers ; 2. a passive emotion or affection (esp. of violent emotion), a passion, passionate desire; in NT always in bad sense: Col.3:5; π. ἀτιμίας, Rom.1:26; π. ἐπιθυμίας, 1Th.4:5.†; SYN.: π. = πάθημα, exc. that πάθημα is the more concrete and particular. In NT usage, π. represents the passive, ungoverned aspect of evil desire, as opposite to…

G3810.definition: (παιδεύω),  ; 1. prop., a teacher, instructor: Rom.2:20. ; 2. a corrector, one who disciplines (cf. Ho, l.with) : Heb.12:9.†; (AS)

G3847.definition: παρά-βασις, -εως, ἡ; (παραβαίνω),  ; 1. a going aside, a deviation (Arist.). ; 2. In later writers, an overstepping; metaphorically, transgression (Plut., al.) : Rom.4:15 5:14, Heb.2:2 9:15; τ. νόμου, Rom.2:23; ἐν π., 1Ti.2:14; τ. παραβάσεων χάριν, Gal.3:19 ; SYN.: see: ἁμαρτία (AS)

G3848.definition: παρα-βάτης, -ου, ὁ; (παραβαίνω),  ; 1. one who stands beside, the warrior who stands by the charioteer (of. παραβαίνω, 1). ; 2. a transgressor (Æsch., παρβάτης): Gal.2:18, Jas.2:9; π. νόμου, Rom.2:25, 27, Jas.2:11.†; (AS)

G3876.definition: παρ-ακοή, -ῆς, ἡ ; 1. a hearing amiss (Flat.); 2. Later, as following inattention, disobedience: Rom.5:19, 2Co.10:6, Heb.2:2 (cf. παρακούω, and see Tr., Syn., § lxvi).†; (AS)

G3804.definition: (πάσχω), like πάθος, ; 1. that which befalls one, a suffering, affliction: pl., Rom.8:18, 2Co.1:6-7, Col.1:24, 2Ti.3:11, Heb.2:10 10:32, 1Pe.5:9; of Christ's sufferings: τὰ εἰς Χ., 1Pe.1:11; τ. Χριστσῦ, 1Pe.5:1; id. as shared by Christians, 2Co.1:5, Php.3:10, 1Pe.4:13. ; 2. a passive emotion, affection, passion: Gal.5:24; τ. ἀμαρτιῶν, Rom.7:5 ; 3. = τὸ πάσχειν, an enduring or suffering: with genitive obj.…

G3873.definition: παρά-κειμαι; to lie beside, be near, be present: Rom.7:18, 21.†; (AS)

G3863.definition: παρα-ζηλόω, -ῶ; to provoke to jealousy: Rom.10:19 (LXX) Rom.11:11, 14, 1Co.10:22.†; (AS)

G3807.definition: (παῖς, ἄγω), ; a guide, guardian, trainer of boys, a tutor (disting. from διδάσκαλος, Xen., Lac., 3, 1), usually a trusty slave: opposite to πατήρ, 1Co.4:15; figuratively, of the Law, π. εἰς Χριστόν, Gal.3:24-25.†; (AS)

G3815.definition: (παῖς),  ; prop., to play as a child, hence, generally, to play (as with singing and dancing) : 1Co.10:7 (LXX) (cf. ἐμ-παίζω).†; (AS)

G3889.definition: (παραμυθέομαι)  ; 1. encouragement, exhortation. ; 2. comfort, consolation: 1Co.14:3 .†; SYN.: παράκλησις (AS)

G3887.definition: παρα-μένω; to remain beside or near: Heb.7:23, Jas.1:25; of remaining alive, 1Co.16:6 (WH, κατα-), Php.1:25 (cf. συμ-παραμένω).†; (AS)

G3835.definition: ready to do anything; (a) in cl., chiefly in bad sense, knavish, crafty: 2Co.12:16; (b) in good sense, skilful, clever (Pro.13:1 28:2).†; (AS)

G3809.definition: (παιδεύω),  ; 1. the rearing of a child (Æsch.). ; 2. training, learning, instruction (Plat., al.): Eph.6:4, 2Ti.3:16. ; 3. As in LXX (Pro.3:11 15:5, al.), chasten­ing, discipline: Heb.12:5 (LXX), Heb.12:7-8, 11.†; (AS)

G3823.definition: (πάλλω, to sway) ; wrestling, hence, generally, fight, contest: figuratively, of the spiritual combat of Christians, Eph.6:12.†; (AS)

G3890.definition: (παραμυθέομαι)  ; 1. an exhortation, persuasion, encouragement: Php.2:1 (cf. Plat., Legg., vi, 773 E, al.; see Lft. and ICC, Phi., l.with). ; 2. assuagement, abatement, hence, consolation (Wis, l.with, and frequently in cl.).†; (AS)

G3897.definition: παρα-πλήσιος, -α, -ον (Hdt., Plat., al.; also -ος, -ον, Thuc., Polyb.), coming near, nearly resembling. Neut. -ον, adverbially, ; = ίως, in a way nearly resembling: with dative, Php.2:27.†; (AS)

G3851.definition: παρα-βολεύομαι; = cl. παραβάλλομαι (2Ma.14:38), ; to expose oneself to danger, hazard one's life: with dative ref., τ. ψυχῇ (see M, Pr., 64), Php.2:30 (Rec. παραβουλ-). Cited by Deiss., LAE, 84, 120.†; παρα-βουλεύομαι, ; to consult amiss, or perh. (see LS, see word), a vulg. form of παρα-βολ- (which see) : Php.2:30, Rec.†; (AS)

G3884.definition: παρα-λογίζομαι; 1. to miscalculate. ; 2. to reason falsely, hence, to mislead: Col.2:4, Jas.1:22.†; (AS)

G3859.definition: παρα-δια-τριβή, -ῆς, ἡ ; useless wrangling: seel. in Rec. for διαπαρατριβή (which see), 1Ti.6:5.†; δια-παρα-τριβή, -ῆς, ἡ ; (παρατριβή, friction, irritation) ; mutual irritation (Field, Notes, 211), wrangling: 1Ti.6:5 (Rec. παραδιατριβή).†; (AS)

G3866.definition: παρα-θήκη, -ης, ἡ; (παρατίθημι),  ; a deposit or trust: 1Ti.6:20, 2Ti.1:12 1:14 (for exx. of this form, see MM, Exp., iii, xviii).†; (AS)

G3898.definition: παρα-πλησίως ; adv. (παραπλήσιος)  ; in like manner: Heb.2:14.†; (AS)

G3894.definition: παρα-πικρασμός, -οῦ, ἁ; (παραπικραίνω)  ; provocation: ἐν τῷ π. (Heb. at Meribah), Heb.3:8, 15" (LXX) .†; (AS)

G3893.definition: παρα-πικραίνω; to embitter, provoke: absol. (yet sc. τ. θεόν, cf. Psa.106:7, Eze.2:5-8, al., and with τὸν θ. added, Psa.5:4, Eze.20:21, al.), Heb.3:16 (cf. παραπικρασμός).†; (AS)

G3895.definition: παρα-πίπτω; 1. most frequently (Hdt., Thuc., al.), to fall in one's way, befall. ; 2. to fall into or in (before εἰς, Polyb.; with dative, 2Mac, l.with). ; 3. to fall away (En, Wis, ll. with; in Polyb., with genitive) : absol., Heb.6:6. ; 4. to fail (λόγος, Es, l.with; cf. 1Ki.3:19).†; (AS)

G3856.definition: παρα-δειγματίζω; (δείκνυμι),  ; to set forth as an example; in bad sense, to put to open shame: Heb.6:6 (Polyb., Plut., al.).†; (AS)

G3831.definition: (πᾶς + ἄγυρας = ἀγορά),  ; prop., a national festal assembly in honour of a god; hence, generally, any festal assembly: Heb.12:23 (for exx. in π., see MM, xviii).†; SYN.: ἐκκλησία (which see), συναγωγή (AS)

G3883.definition: παρ-αλλαγή, -ῆς, ἡ; (παραλλάσσω),  ; in various senses (LS, see word), change: Jas.1:17.†; (AS)
